name: Lipprop
description: Settles into the guard with qi pooled in the forearm so the blade holds against a hard cut.

name: Acrid Deepbelly
description: Cuts the forehand line with qi threaded to the edge so it bites a little deeper than steel alone.

name: Fleet Flowedge
description: Lightens the heels with a breath of qi and slips a half pace aside from a thrust.

name: Swellback Barrier
description: Slides the flat across the foe's cut with qi easing the contact and sending it wide.

name: Talwarflog
description: Drives qi into the wrist at the instant of impact so the belly of the blade lands with extra weight.

name: Talwarslap
description: Turns the rebound of a held guard into an immediate return cut along the blade's own arc.

name: Dense Flaretip
description: Feeds qi into the curve of the blade and holds it across the body as a guard.

name: Rugged Scoop
description: Cuts a clean arc with qi flowing steadily from the shoulder along the blade to the point.

name: Bold Carve
description: Pulls the blade back along the arc it just cut to open a second line.

name: Lipbarrier
description: Checks the opponent's wrist with the inside of the curve and unbalances the next cut.

name: Cantlezip
description: Slides backward on a pulse of qi in the legs while the blade covers the line of retreat.

name: Layered Crescent
description: Catches a downward chop in the hollow of the curve and holds it with the spine braced.

name: Ruthless Saddleguard
description: Holds a stream of qi along the blade through a long drawing cut that reaches past its steel length.

name: Layered Talwar
description: Lets the guard flow back with qi cushioning the blade so a heavy blow slides off the curve.

name: Unmoving Broadcurve
description: Sets the feet and the blade in the opening position that the draw begins from.

name: Brisk Cantle
description: Pulls the edge across the target in a long draw that finishes behind the hip.

name: Scimhilt Thwack
description: Answers a parry by drawing the blade out of the bind and slicing the wrist.

name: Scoopstalk
description: Follows the retreating foe with a half step so the draw keeps its reach.

name: Unmoving Flowedge
description: Returns the blade to guard along the draw's path and sweeps a counter-cut aside.

name: Hungry Arcwheel
description: Whets the draw with qi at the moment the edge meets cloth or leather and parts it cleanly.

name: Carvethwack
description: Draws the edge twice in one breath along a single line to cut through a held guard.

name: Talwarscreen
description: Rotates the guard through high and low and outside as a single ring before each drill round.

name: Brutal Scoop
description: Cuts once and resets to the starting guard in a count that partners can match.

name: Saddleguard Buckle
description: Meets the partner's edge at a set angle and holds it there to feel the force.

name: Lopcurl
description: Steps around the four corners of a marked square while the blade keeps pointing inward.

name: Wild Carve
description: Beats the blade against a padded post with qi toughening the forearm.

name: Crescent Swat
description: Cuts through the narrow gap between two posts without touching either.

name: Cruel Arcwheel
description: Chains three cuts on one held breath of qi with the blade never leaving its arc.

name: Carveslap
description: Wheels the blade up over the foe's block and cuts down behind it before the guard resets.

name: Sturdy Deepbelly
description: Roots the stance with qi in the thighs and holds the guard through several heavy blows.

name: Hungry Lop
description: Cuts the first round of the book from a still stance with every joint aligned.

name: Talwar Hammerfall
description: Rolls the wrist at a slant so the edge arrives from an angle the guard did not cover.

name: Scoopzip
description: Slips outside the cut by a hand-width and lets the blade pass the shoulder.

name: Talwarbuckle
description: Collapses the guard inward and braces the pommel against the ribs to take a blow.

name: Gagging Broadcurve
description: Scoops the curve beneath a long haft and lifts it clear of the line of attack.

name: Lopglide
description: Rolls from heel to toe in a long stride that keeps the point on a backing foe.

name: Lurching Whipcut
description: Sweeps the level belly through a hanging cloth in one clean stroke without tearing it free.

name: Grim Cantle
description: Threads a thin line of qi through a long arc so the cut keeps its speed to the end.

name: Rough Swellback
description: Returns the blade point-down and drives the weighted spine into the foe's lowered guard.

name: Resolute Scimhilt
description: Spins the blade in a shield of small arcs before the body to turn aside a flurry.

name: Talwarprop
description: Opens with the blade held low and wide while the feet begin to circle.

name: Clay Whipcut
description: Flicks the edge across the opponent's near forearm while passing on the outside.

name: Claylip
description: Paces the outer circle around a stationary foe to find the weaker side.

name: Lopswat
description: Turns the body at the end of a circle and cuts into the foe's open flank.

name: Splice Flaretip
description: Hooks the blade over a thrusting arm and draws it across the body.

name: Savage Arcwheel
description: Builds qi through the whole circle and releases it in a single sweeping cut at the end.

name: Viselike Saddleguard
description: Hooks the foe's weapon arm and releases at full stretch to throw their balance off.

name: Cantlehasp
description: Plants both feet and holds the blade across the body in the canon's first guard.

name: Brasscantle
description: Holds the blade across the pommel of the saddle with the off hand low on the rein.

name: Brutal Lop
description: Slashes a passing rider from the saddle with a long arm and a turned wrist.

name: Lipthwack
description: Draws the edge up and through a rider's leg from the ground as the horse passes.

name: Carvestalk
description: Slides the weight along the saddle to the off side to open a clear arc for the blade.

name: Humtalwar
description: Turns aside a cut from a moving seat using the flat and the roll of the shoulders.

name: Honed Broadcurve
description: Gathers qi from the speed of the mount and lays it into a single hard slash.

name: Burdening Lop
description: Hooks the curve behind a rider's elbow and hauls them sideways out of the saddle.

name: Sprig Flowedge
description: Waits in guard and counts the opponent's breaths to find a rhythm to break.

name: Hum Cantle
description: Slides the curve along a straight blade so that its point is led harmlessly past.

name: Deepbelly Scorer
description: Bends the cut around a straight guard so that the belly lands behind it.

name: Talwar Hurdle
description: Steps in a half beat early so the foe's cut finds empty air and the curve finds the foe.

name: Crimson Scimhilt
description: Cuts on the off-beat with a burst of qi that the opponent's rhythm cannot anticipate.

name: Flaretip Carapace
description: Yields along the blade's arc and then reverses it with qi to turn the foe's force back on them.

name: Brass Swellback
description: Opens with the hooked point forward and the spine covering the knuckles.

name: Tethering Carve
description: Slips the hook over an extended wrist and tightens the curve around it.

name: Static Scoop
description: Pulls the trapped arm open and cuts across the exposed ribs in one motion.

name: Veering Rake
description: Strides away on the hooked side so the dragged weapon lengthens the foe's reach to nothing.

name: Discord Rake
description: Checks a hand at the crossguard with the near hook and wrenches the grip loose.

name: Rill Crescent
description: Catches a falling blade on the hooked point and turns it down and away.

name: Splice Arcwheel
description: Tightens the hook with a steady stream of qi until the trapped weapon cannot be drawn out.

name: Wild Rake
description: Lifts the hook to carry the foe's blade overhead and cuts down the exposed side.

name: Gall Whipcut
description: Lets the hook go on a snap of qi so the foe falls back from the sudden slack.
